comment: Canonical React Native dependency patches shared across the family. Each entry names the canonical patch file (under bun/ or patch-package/), the mechanism that consumes it, and the sibling projects (relative to ~/projects) that vendor a copy. scripts/sync_rn_patches.sh copies the canonical file into each consumer's patches/ dir so every project stays byte-identical. Patches stay vendored per-project (bun's patchedDependencies, and patch-package, both need the file physically present, and CI runs `bun install --frozen-lockfile` with no access to this repo) -- this is a single source of truth plus a sync step, not a runtime dependency.

patches.why: Native Swift fix in ios/TabViewImpl.swift (compile-level; cannot be swizzled). Must stay until fixed upstream in a release the family adopts.

C++ ReactCommon renderer fixes (ShadowNode/ShadowNodeFamily/UIManager nativeProps_DEPRECATED mutex) + Modal sheet + View recycle hover-reset (compile-level; cannot be swizzled). Re-ported from 0.81.9 to 0.83.0 on 2026-10-27 and validated by a macOS xcodebuild. The nil-class codegen hunk was removed on 2026-10-28 once @sudobility/components-rn@1.0.133 shipped the runtime swizzle (MoosiacThirdPartyComponentsFix) that handles it for every app. Renderer fixes upstreamed as microsoft/react-native-macos#3155.
Adds macOS support to the podspec + source (compile-level; still :ios-only upstream at 0.13.6). Music family only.

macOS CGImage extraction (NSImage has no .CGImage; both didReceiveImage sites) + Svg.tsx + Windows RNSVG Fabric renderer fixes (per-element redraw, leaked document per redraw). Compile-level. Re-based from 15.12.1 on 2026-10-27: the NSImage signature and the RNSVGSvgView wantsUpdateLayer override are now upstream in 15.16, so those hunks were dropped. Validated by a macOS xcodebuild.

macOS support (compile-level): WebGPUView.h uses the cross-platform RNWGUIKit header instead of UIKit, RNWGUIKit.h fixes the AppKit casing + adds CAMetalLayer, MetalView.mm adds isFlipped so macOS gestures use a top-left origin. Still needed at 0.19.2 (not upstream). music_app_rn-webgpu-spike only. Bumped 0.13.0 -> 0.19.2 during the 0.83 port; the 0.13.0 hunks applied unchanged. Validated by a macOS xcodebuild.

obsolete.comment: Patches that upstream has absorbed; they should be DELETED from the projects that still vendor them, not centralized.
obsolete.@shopify+react-native-skia: macOS Metal context fixes are upstream at skia >= 2.13. Dropped when music moved to skia 2.13.0 (2026-10-27); sudojo dropped it earlier at the same version.
obsolete.react-native-svg (RNSVGSvgView wantsUpda: Upstream in react-native-svg 15.16.0; those hunks removed from the re-based svg patch. The CGImage extraction and Windows hunks are still needed.
obsolete.react-native-safe-area-context+5.6.2: react-native-safe-area-context@5.6.2 ships src/NativeSafeAreaProvider.windows.tsx upstream (a re-export of CompatNativeSafeAreaProvider); that upstream file is what lands in node_modules, so the patch's custom View-backed provider never took effect. REMOVED from music_app_rn and music_app_rn-webgpu-spike on 2026-10-27; music_player_app_rn never had it. If music's Windows modals turn out to need the custom zero-inset provider, it must be re-done as a MODIFY of the upstream file, not a new-file create.

notes.music_app_rn-webgpu-spike: Ported to RN 0.83.10 on 2026-10-28 (webgpu 0.13.0 -> 0.19.2); now a consumer of the shared music patches + its own webgpu patch, all macOS-build-validated. Pre-existing non-RN debt left as-is: `three/webgpu` has no shipped types (three 0.186 ships none), and 2 unit tests fail (i18n key parity, a Windows rendering assertion).
